svg.title: Honest limits of TRACE
svg.desc: Four limits. Ordinary keyword search did better on our test: it found the right passage more often and answered faster. TRACE takes more space on disk (2.28 GB, against 1.25 GB for a plain vector copy and 0.51 GB for the keyword index), and we make no speed claim. While answering questions, the live service peaked near 1 GB of memory. The testing is small: 50 test searches, and the public standard tests (BEIR) have not been run. The live service is switched off and the run-it-yourself kit is only planned. We claim only what we measured, and nothing more.
svg.text: What TRACE does not do, said plainly.
